How to play+
  1. Read the calculation and select an answer. There is no time limit.
  2. Correct answers continue automatically. If you make a mistake, you can review the answer first.
  3. Complete ten questions to see your score.
About Mental Math+

Play Mental Math online

Mental arithmetic has long been part of classroom and family number games. This version keeps the familiar calculations, adds multiple-choice answers and leaves out the countdown clock.

Why it works+

You retrieve number facts, hold intermediate results in mind and check the options. Untimed questions let accuracy and a comfortable pace take priority.

These are the skills used during play; improvement outside the game is not established.
